# Build Report

## Purpose

This document captures build metadata and metrics for traceability, debugging, and release readiness.

## Notes

- This report is generated automatically on production builds.
- The authoritative metadata is stored in the YAML frontmatter.

## Key Artifacts

- `main.js` (bundled plugin entry)
- `manifest.json`
- `styles.css`
- `LICENSE`

## Checklist

- [ ] Plugin loads in Obsidian
- [ ] No console errors on startup
- [ ] Commands and views register correctly
- [ ] Settings tab renders
